# Midsummer crown

Internal ID: HelmetMidsummerCrown | Type: Head | Source: Workbench | Season: Midsummer | Crafting Materials: Dandelion, x10 | Armor: 1

# Introduction

Midsummer crown is a seasonal armor piece available during midsummer.
The crown provides 1 armor and has no additional effect.

## Availability

Crafted with Dandelion x10 at a Workbench from 1 June – 6 July as part of the Midsummer event.

Categorias: Armor, Head, Workbench recipes
